Subject: Feature packaging for pilot — questions

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for last week's demo. The team at PulseHealth is keen to run a 3-month pilot but we're trying to understand how features map to tiers — specifically we want to: 

- Limit spend during pilot while validating model quality (we expect ~2–3M tokens/month)
- Test data privacy with a dedicated VPC option later on
- Only pay for the high-throughput endpoints for a subset of internal users

Our procurement lead asked whether we can:
1) Move certain premium features (structured output and function tool-calling) into a purchasable add-on rather than requiring the higher tier;
2) Receive a pilot discount or credits to offset the first month while we complete the integration;
3) Get a concisely scoped mutual action plan (MAP) that ties deliverables to payment milestones.

Can you share a recommended packaging approach (tier + add-ons) and an outline for the MAP? Also, any known constraints on mixing dedicated capacity for only a subset of endpoints?

Appreciate the help — copying our procurement team so they see the answers.

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Product Integrations, PulseHealth
elnap@pulsehealth.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Feature packaging for pilot — questions

Hi Elena — great to hear you're ready to pilot. High level answers first, with a follow-up attachment that lays out a proposed MAP and a modular package.

1) Feature bundling: We can move structured output and function/tool-calling into an add-on SKU ("Structured+Tools") which can be attached to any tier for the pilot. That lets you start on the Core tier for general throughput and enable the add-on only for the teams that need it.

2) Pilot credits: We typically offer a time-bound credit for pilots of this size. For a 3-month engagement at ~2–3M tokens/month we can propose a $15k credit applied to the first invoice (equivalent to ~X% depending on actual token mix). If you require a formal discount instead of a credit we can provide a 20% off the first month's usage for deals that go into an annual contract after pilot.

3) Dedicated capacity for subset of endpoints: Short answer — yes. We support routing policies so you can pin select endpoints to Dedicated pools while keeping the rest on Hosted. There is a minimum capacity commitment for Dedicated pools; for pilot we can provision a scoped burst pool and use routing rules to limit which API keys hit it. I'll loop in Ben (SE) to confirm latency/throughput numbers and any minimums.

I'm attaching a recommended package (PDF) and a draft MAP spreadsheet. If you like, we can get a 30-minute call on Thursday to walk the MAP and finalize the PO path.

Best,
Sofia

Sofia — quick notes from SE perspective:

- Dedicated: we can spin a small dedicated pool equivalent to ~1xA100 for the pilot. For the two endpoints you're pinning, expect sustained throughput ~150 tokens/sec combined under typical prompt lengths. Cold-start latency will be in the 80–120ms range and KV cache hit rates will be important for lower tail latency.
- Burst: we can allow limited burst capacity for short windows (10–15 minutes) without raising the monthly commit, but repeated bursts will trigger an autoscale event and we'd need to discuss burst pricing; for pilot that should be fine.
- Structured+Tools billing: best to model as a feature add-on priced as a per-endpoint flat monthly surcharge for the pilot (easier for procurement). If they scale to annual we can convert to a seat-based or per-call metering with adjusted economics.

I think the $15k credit is reasonable from an SE/regional quota standpoint. Marcus — can you confirm approval thresholds?

Ben

Hi Elena — thanks for the patience. Attached is a compact proposal and a draft MAP for the 3-month pilot. Summary below so your procurement team has the quick facts.

Summary proposal (pilot):
- Base tier: Core (hosted) for general endpoints
- Add-on: Structured+Tools (flat add-on per pinned endpoint) — enable for the two internal endpoints you flagged
- Dedicated: scoped small Dedicated pool (1xA100 equivalent) pinned to the two endpoints via routing policy
- Pricing: estimated usage for pilot (2.5M tokens/mo avg) → list price ~$22k/month. Proposed commercial support: $15k credit applied to first invoice OR 20% off month-1 if you sign an annual contract before pilot end.
- Billing mechanics: pilot billed net of credits; add-on and Dedicated usage shown as separate line items.

Draft MAP (attached):
- Milestone 1 (Kickoff, Week 0): sign SOW & initial PO; Redwood provisions Dedicated pool. Payment: 50% of pilot expected invoice (net of credit).
- Milestone 2 (Integration & smoke tests, Week 2–3): enable Structured+Tools on test endpoints; validation period. Payment: remaining pilot invoice (net of credit) or offset depending on usage.
- Milestone 3 (Pilot review, Week 12): decision to convert to annual contract or sunset. If convert, credits applied as agreed.

Attachments included: PH_Pilot_Proposal_v2.pdf, MA_ActionPlan_Pulse.xlsx. Also linking the HubSpot deal and DocuSign for signature: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/PH-2027-058 and https://www.docusign.net/Tx12345

If this looks good I can send a short SOW + DocuSign and we can aim to start provisioning the week of May 24. Do you want us to convert the add-on to a seat-based price for procurement simplicity, or keep it as a flat per-endpoint surcharge for the pilot?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-minute call to run through.
